t: The Mining Dimension is useful to set up quarries to mine in. It is also useful to use as a testing area since it is a superflat dimension. To teleport to the dimension use the $(l:dimensions/teleport_pad)Teleport Pad$(/c) in the Overworld.
挖矿维度适合搭建采石场进行采矿，也适合作为测试区域，因为这是一个超平坦维度。要传送到该维度，请在主世界中使用$(l:dimensions/teleport_pad)传送垫$(/c)。
